_comment: Synthetic notes for Phase 0 model benchmarks only. Replaced by a real eval set over the vault in Phase 2.

notes.text:
# Sourdough
## Formula
I settled on 75% hydration with 2% salt and 20% levain. Higher hydration made the crumb too gummy with my flour.
## Schedule
Feed the starter at 9pm, mix at 8am, bulk ferment about 5 hours at 24C, shape, then cold retard overnight.

# Rust learning plan
#rust #learning
## Goal
Ship a small CLI by end of Q4. Chapters 1-10 of the Book first.
## Lifetimes
The thing that finally clicked: a lifetime annotation does not change how long anything lives, it only describes relationships so the borrow checker can verify them.

# Home server
The AETHERION box runs WSL2 with an RTX 3060. Ollama listens on port 11434. Backups go to the external drive labelled VAULT-B every night at 02:30 using restic.

# Deep Work — Cal Newport
## Takeaways
Schedule every minute of the workday. Shutdown ritual: say 'schedule shutdown, complete' out loud. Aim for four hours of deep work per day as the practical ceiling.

# Aurora sync 2026-10-05
Attendees: Mia, Tom. Decision: migrate the ingestion service from Kafka to Redis Streams to cut ops cost. Tom owns the migration; deadline 2026-10-30. Risk: consumer group semantics differ.

# Budget 2026
Monthly targets: groceries $600, dining $250, transport $180. Emergency fund goal is six months of expenses, currently at four. Max out the Roth IRA by April.

# Running
Training for the Chicago half marathon. Long run on Sundays, building from 10 km to 18 km. Easy pace target 6:15/km; tempo 5:20/km. Left knee flares up above 40 km per week.

# Japanese study log
Using Anki with the Kaishi 1.5k deck, 20 new cards a day. Weak point is listening. Next milestone: pass JLPT N4 in December 2026.

# Postgres notes
## Vacuum
For the big events table set autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor to 0.02 instead of the default 0.2, otherwise bloat builds up for days.
## pgvector
HNSW with m=16 and ef_construction=64 was a good default; raise ef_search to 100 for better recall.

# Gift ideas
Mom: a pour-over coffee set (she liked the Hario V60 at the cafe). Dad: noise-cancelling headphones for flights. Sister: a pottery class voucher.
